title: task
$comment: A bounded unit of work (e.g. PROJ-1409). Lives under a project, or standalone (project=null). Required fields ARE the KICKOFF gate (C.1): context · status · to-do · done_when · scope. entry_points powers the warm-context load (R5: working set <=8 reads). The pilot specimen (research/.../bench/canonical.json) is this type.

project.$comment: Parent project id, or null for a standalone task (lightweight tier).

context.$comment: Triad: what this work is + the e2e flow / root-cause / rule / fix narrative.

todo.$comment: Triad: the to-do list (subtasks + open items), each with its own status so open work is queryable.

scope.$comment: The scope contract the PLAN must cover whole (C.2) and the DONE-GATE checks (R7). in/out + the repos/files/feeds it touches.

done_when.$comment: Falsifiable definition-of-done checklist (design/wire/docs included, not just code). The DONE-GATE blocks `wrap` until met (R7). >=1 item.

entry_points.$comment: Files/symbols/anchors to load the working set from (SCOUT/REHYDRATOR target -> R5 <=8 reads, 0 re-reads).

verification.$comment: Optional preserved evidence the done_when was met (test counts, gate verdicts).
